resources.string: Start the gateway on your computer, then scan the QR code it shows.
Select a host and tap Connect, or add a new one.
Point at the QR code shown on your computer
That doesn\'t look like a gateway link — it must include the ?t= token.
No saved token for that computer — scan its QR once, or paste the full link including ?t=.
The gateway refused the token. Scan the QR from the computer again.
Can\'t reach the computer. Is the gateway running and the phone on the same network / VPN?
"%1$s" will be removed and you\'ll need to scan its QR again to reconnect.
